A *tuning or right-sizing judgment* with no AWS-published number is marked `workload-specific` at severity INFO; a *binary present/absent/failed* state (a job FAILED, no checkpoint produced, access denied) keeps its catalog severity even when AWS publishes no number.\\n\\n## Real-time inference endpoints (LLM-SM-001..011)\\n\\nCovers Amazon SageMaker real-time inference endpoints \u2014 reliability, operational excellence, cost, security, and performance/right-sizing posture.\\n\\n| check-id | pillar | severity | detection-rule | remediation | AWS-doc-citation |\\n|---|---|---|---|---|---|\\n| LLM-SM-001 | Reliability | HIGH | `DescribeEndpoint` production variant has no Application Auto Scaling target registered (`DescribeScalableTargets` empty for the endpoint/variant) \u2014 fixed capacity that cannot absorb load spikes or scale in when idle. | Register the variant with Application Auto Scaling and attach a target-tracking policy (e.g., on `SageMakerVariantInvocationsPerInstance`). | https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sagemaker/latest/dg/endpoint-auto-scaling.html |\\n| LLM-SM-002 | Operational Excellence | HIGH | Endpoint config has `DataCaptureConfig` disabled / absent and no Model Monitor schedule \u2014 no capture of inference inputs/outputs, so drift and data-quality monitoring are impossible. | Enable `DataCaptureConfig` on the endpoint config and attach a Model Monitor schedule (data quality / model quality). | https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sagemaker/latest/dg/model-monitor.html |\\n| LLM-SM-003 | Cost Optimization | HIGH | A production variant reports `CurrentInstanceCount` = 0 (and is not a serverless or scale-to-zero config) \u2014 endpoint is `InService` but cannot serve, or is a leftover variant still billed by config. | Investigate: if abandoned, delete the endpoint; if intended scale-to-zero, confirm serverless/async config; otherwise restore desired instance count. | https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sagemaker/latest/dg/realtime-endpoints.html |\\n| LLM-SM-004 | Operational Excellence | MEDIUM | Only a single production variant exists where safe model rollout matters \u2014 no multi-variant setup for A/B testing or canary shifting of traffic between model versions. | Add a second production variant and shift traffic gradually (variant weights) to A/B test or canary new model versions. | https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sagemaker/latest/dg/model-ab-testing.html |\\n| LLM-SM-005 | Performance | MEDIUM | Instance type/count chosen without running Inference Recommender \u2014 likely oversized (cost) or undersized (latency) relative to the model's measured profile. | Run an Inference Recommender job to right-size instance type/count against latency and throughput targets. Threshold `workload-specific`. | https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sagemaker/latest/dg/inference-recommender.html |\\n| LLM-SM-006 | Security | HIGH | Endpoint config / model has no `VpcConfig` where the workload requires private networking \u2014 inference traffic and model artifacts are not confined to the VPC. | Configure `VpcConfig` (subnets + security groups) on the model so the endpoint runs inside the VPC; use VPC endpoints for AWS API access. | https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sagemaker/latest/dg/host-vpc.html |\\n| LLM-SM-007 | Security | HIGH | Endpoint config `KmsKeyId` absent \u2014 the ML storage volume attached to inference instances is not encrypted with a customer-managed key. | Set `KmsKeyId` on the endpoint config (CMK) to encrypt the inference instance storage volume. | https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sagemaker/latest/APIReference/API_CreateEndpointConfig.html |\\n| LLM-SM-008 | Cost Optimization | MEDIUM | Low, bursty, or latency-tolerant traffic served by an always-on real-time endpoint instead of Serverless Inference or Asynchronous Inference \u2014 paying for idle instances. Endpoint-side idle-cost signal only; the serverless/async fit decision is LLM-SM-SERVE-005 in this skill's serverless/async area. | Move spiky low-volume traffic to Serverless Inference, and large-payload/long-running inference to Asynchronous Inference. Threshold `workload-specific`. | https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sagemaker/latest/dg/serverless-endpoints.html |\\n| LLM-SM-009 | Reliability | MEDIUM | Sustained `ModelLatency`/`OverheadLatency` growth or `Invocation5XXErrors` > 0 over the window with no alarm \u2014 endpoint degradation is undetected (see cloudwatch-alarm-reference.md). | Add CloudWatch alarms on `ModelLatency` and `Invocation5XXErrors`; investigate container/model-server health. | https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sagemaker/latest/dg/monitoring-cloudwatch.html |\\n| LLM-SM-010 | Performance | LOW | GPU-backed LLM endpoint shows low `GPUUtilization`/`GPUMemoryUtilization` sustained \u2014 over-provisioned GPU, or model would fit a smaller/cheaper accelerator. Threshold `workload-specific`. | Right-size to a smaller GPU instance or consolidate via multi-model/multi-container endpoints; re-validate latency. | https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sagemaker/latest/dg/monitoring-cloudwatch.html |\\n| LLM-SM-011 | Operational Excellence | LOW | Endpoint not deployed via a tracked model package / registry version \u2014 the running model artifact has no lineage to a registered, approved version. Threshold `workload-specific`. | Register models in the SageMaker Model Registry and deploy approved package versions for traceability. | https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sagemaker/latest/dg/model-registry.html |\\n\\n## Serverless & asynchronous inference (LLM-SM-SERVE-*)\\n\\nCovers the serverless/async-specific posture the always-on real-time checks (LLM-SM-001..011) cannot \u2014 cold start, concurrency, async queue/notification wiring, and the fit decision.\\n\\n| check-id | pillar | severity | detection-rule | remediation | AWS-doc-citation |\\n|---|---|---|---|---|---|\\n| LLM-SM-SERVE-001 | Performance | MEDIUM | Serverless endpoint shows elevated `ModelSetupTime` (cold-start) in `AWS/SageMaker` with no Provisioned Concurrency configured on the `ServerlessConfig` \u2014 first-call latency spikes under bursty traffic. Threshold `workload-specific`. | Set Provisioned Concurrency on the serverless variant sized to the concurrent-request floor, or move latency-critical paths to a real-time endpoint; re-measure `ModelSetupTime`. | https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sagemaker/latest/dg/serverless-endpoints.html |\\n| LLM-SM-SERVE-002 | Reliability | MEDIUM | Serverless `ServerlessConfig.MaxConcurrency` set at/near the account or config ceiling while invocations are being throttled \u2014 concurrency headroom exhausted. Threshold `workload-specific`. | Raise `MaxConcurrency` (within account limits) or add Provisioned Concurrency; if the ceiling is an account quota, request an increase. Confirm throttles are sustained, not a blip. | https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sagemaker/latest/dg/serverless-endpoints.html |\\n| LLM-SM-SERVE-003 | Reliability | HIGH | Asynchronous endpoint has `AsyncInferenceConfig` present but **no** `OutputConfig.NotificationConfig` (SNS success/error topics) \u2014 callers have no completion signal and failures are silent. | Configure `NotificationConfig` with `SuccessTopic` and `ErrorTopic` so completion and failure are observable; verify the endpoint role can publish to the topics. | https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sagemaker/latest/dg/async-inference.html |\\n| LLM-SM-SERVE-004 | Reliability | MEDIUM | Async endpoint has no scale-to-zero / scaling on the `ApproximateBacklogSizePerInstance` metric \u2014 the queue backs up with no instances or pays for idle instances between bursts. Owns the serverless/async fit decision, driven by payload size and invocation duration; the real-time idle-cost signal stays LLM-SM-008 in this skill's real-time area. Threshold `workload-specific`. | Move large-payload/long-running inference to Asynchronous Inference and spiky low-volume traffic to Serverless; re-validate latency and cost. Complements LLM-SM-008 from the real-time side. | https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sagemaker/latest/dg/model-deploy-feature-matrix.html |\\n\\n## Batch transform / offline scoring (LLM-SM-BATCH-*)\\n\\nBatch Transform is the offline-scoring path for LLMs (bulk classification, offline generation). Covers failure, right-sizing, output integrity, and encryption.\\n\\n| check-id | pillar | severity | detection-rule | remediation | AWS-doc-citation |\\n|---|---|---|---|---|---|\\n| LLM-SM-BATCH-001 | Reliability | HIGH | `DescribeTransformJob` `TransformJobStatus` = `Failed` \u2014 read `FailureReason` for input-data format mismatch, a `ContentType`/`SplitType` the container rejects, or an S3 access error on the input/output path. | Fix the indicated cause (correct `ContentType`/`SplitType`/`BatchStrategy`, or grant the role S3 access to input/output prefixes) and resubmit; validate a small sample first. | https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sagemaker/latest/dg/batch-transform.html |\\n| LLM-SM-BATCH-002 | Performance | LOW | Batch job runs with `MaxConcurrentTransforms` = 1 / default and no `MaxPayloadInMB` tuning on a large dataset \u2014 under-parallelized, long wall-clock and higher cost.
